plain_result: Top-5 routing kept the right conversation for all ten questions. Qwen returned a faithful, message-grounded answer from nine of the ten right conversations, but the full locked gate failed: one long-chat answer broke the tool format, and 17 of 40 distractor conversations also produced FOUND.
privacy: No conversation text, private paths, raw model output, source hashes or unreviewed claims are published.

human_review.reviewer: Morrow in the active owner task
human_review.method: For every expected conversation, compare the model claim with every cited private message. For distractors, inspect every FOUND claim and its cited messages. Publish only safe summaries.
human_review.finding: The nine usable answers were faithful. The 17 distractor FOUND claims were unsupported, about a different case, or repeated the question without evidence. Existing message coordinates prove where text came from; they do not prove that the text supports the claim.

questions.safe_review: Correctly found the integrity checks for the moved corpus and PostgreSQL backup and cited existing messages.
Correctly stated that both the growing swarm and exact RAG reached 100%, so superiority was not shown.
Correctly found the recurring public-key refusal and its effect on GPU workers.
Correctly found the review about the IDAT-only limit and unchecked ancillary/APNG data.
Failed. The relevant long-chat area was supplied, but Qwen did not finish a valid tool call.
Correctly found the review where a signed audit described traffic sent to a canned-response component.
Correctly found the private checkout check blocked by Docker socket and loopback restrictions.
Correctly found the receipt-loader review and the missing root-name comparison.
Correctly found the handoff that granted repository write operations.
Correctly found the explanation that the plugin was installed and Codex needed a restart and a newly opened project.

decision.why: The reader recovered nine of ten target facts, but cannot yet be trusted to reject similar chats and is less stable on long-chat areas.
decision.next: Keep top-5 routing. Treat Qwen outputs as candidates with provenance, not accepted knowledge. Apply the already-tested evidence and acceptance modules before a claim enters the answer shelf.
